# ------ Differential Gene Expression ---------------

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Script 01: Data Loading, Metadata Cleaning, Age Mapping & Export
# Datasets: GSE90514 & GSE167529
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load isoform & gene count matrices from DTU exam server
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
load("/home/projects/22140/exam_data/exam_functions.Rdata")

iso_90514  <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE90514")
iso_167529 <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE167529")

gene_90514  <- extractGeneCountMatrixFromIsoCounts(iso_90514)
gene_167529 <- extractGeneCountMatrixFromIsoCounts(iso_167529)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Download & parse raw GEO metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. GSE90514 (Series Matrix)
parse_geo_meta <- function(url, destfile) {
  if (!file.exists(destfile)) {
    download.file(url = url, destfile = destfile, mode = "wb")
  }
  lines <- readLines(destfile)
  sample_lines <- lines[grepl("^!Sample_", lines)]
  parsed <- strsplit(sample_lines, "\t")
  attr_names <- make.unique(gsub("^!Sample_", "", sapply(parsed, `[`, 1)))
  
  df <- as.data.frame(
    lapply(parsed, function(x) gsub('^"|"$', "", x[-1])),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  colnames(df) <- attr_names
  rownames(df) <- df$geo_accession
  df
}

dir.create("../data/_raw", showWarning = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
meta_90514_raw <- parse_geo_meta(
  "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE90nnn/GSE90514/matrix/GSE90514_series_matrix.txt.gz",
  "../data/_raw/GSE90514_series_matrix.txt.gz"
)

# B. GSE167529 (SOFT file — combines all platforms/batches in one file)
soft_file <- "../data/_raw/GSE167529_family.soft.gz"
if (!file.exists(soft_file)) {
  download.file(
    url = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE167nnn/GSE167529/soft/GSE167529_family.soft.gz",
    destfile = soft_file,
    mode = "wb"
  )
}

soft_lines    <- readLines(soft_file)
sample_starts <- grep("^\\^SAMPLE = ", soft_lines)
sample_ends   <- c(sample_starts[-1] - 1, length(soft_lines))

meta_167529_raw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sample_starts), function(i) {
  block <- soft_lines[sample_starts[i]:sample_ends[i]]
  gsm   <- sub("^\\^SAMPLE = ", "", block[1])
  title <- sub("^!Sample_title = ", "", grep("^!Sample_title = ", block, value = TRUE)[1])
  plat  <- sub("^!Sample_platform_id = ", "", grep("^!Sample_platform_id = ", block, value = TRUE)[1])
  chars <- sub("^!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = ", "", grep("^!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = ", block, value = TRUE))
  data.frame(
    geo_accession    = gsm,
    title            = title,
    platform_id      = plat,
    characteristics  = paste(chars, collapse = " | "),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
rownames(meta_167529_raw) <- meta_167529_raw$geo_accession

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Clean metadata & map patient age (AAD from Table 2, PMC8636510)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. GSE90514
meta_90514 <- meta_90514_raw[colnames(gene_90514), ]
meta_90514$condition <- factor(
  ifelse(grepl("healthy control", meta_90514$characteristics_ch1, ignore.case = TRUE),
         "Control", "PD"),
  levels = c("Control", "PD")
)
meta_90514$gender <- factor(
  trimws(sub("^gender:\\s*", "", meta_90514$characteristics_ch1.2, ignore.case = TRUE))
)
meta_90514 <- meta_90514[, c("geo_accession", "title", "condition", "gender")]
stopifnot(all(rownames(meta_90514) == colnames(gene_90514)))

# B. GSE167529
extract_field <- function(x, key) {
  pattern <- paste0(".*", key, ":\\s*([^|]+).*")
  ifelse(grepl(pattern, x, ignore.case = TRUE),
         trimws(sub(pattern, "\\1", x, ignore.case = TRUE)),
         NA_character_)
}

meta_167529 <- meta_167529_raw[colnames(gene_167529), ]
meta_167529$disease_raw <- extract_field(meta_167529$characteristics, "disease state")
meta_167529$condition <- factor(
  ifelse(grepl("healthy control", meta_167529$disease_raw, ignore.case = TRUE),
         "Control", "PD"),
  levels = c("Control", "PD")
)
meta_167529$glucose <- factor(extract_field(meta_167529$characteristics, "glucose"))
meta_167529$gender  <- factor(extract_field(meta_167529$characteristics, "gender"))
meta_167529$batch   <- factor(extract_field(meta_167529$characteristics, "batch"))
meta_167529$run     <- factor(meta_167529$platform_id)

# Age-at-Donation (AAD) lookup from Table 2 of PMC8636510
aad_lookup <- c(
  "SP-01" = 63, "SP-02" = 55, "SP-04" = 46, "SP-06" = 44, "SP-09" = 66,
  "SP-11" = 48, "SP-12" = 63, "SP-13" = 68, "FOX-073-001" = 66, "SP-16" = 51,
  "SP-17" = 52, "FOX-019-001" = 71, "FOX-075-001" = 51, "FOX-015-001" = 68,
  "SP-08" = 66, "IPD-008" = 65, "CTRL-001" = 68, "CTRL-002" = 73,
  "CTRL-003" = 55, "FOX-076-001" = 61, "FOX-069-001" = 64
)

extract_donor <- function(titles) {
  x <- sub("^[^(]*\\(", "", titles)                    # drop everything up to "("
  x <- sub("\\).*$", "", x)                            # drop ")" and anything after (if present)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- sub("[_[:space:]]+(high|low)$", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)  # drop "_low", " high", etc.
  sub("^FOX(\\d)", "FOX-\\1", x)                       # FOX073-001 -> FOX-073-001
}

meta_167529$donor_id   <- extract_donor(meta_167529$title)
meta_167529$age        <- as.numeric(aad_lookup[meta_167529$donor_id])
meta_167529$age_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(meta_167529$age))
meta_167529$age_group  <- factor(ifelse(meta_167529$age >= 60, ">=60", "<60"))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta_167529$age)), all(rownames(meta_167529) == colnames(gene_167529)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Subset GSE167529 to 25 mM glucose (main analysis) & align isoform matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
keep_25mM <- grepl("25", meta_167529$glucose)
gene_167529_25mM <- gene_167529[, keep_25mM]
meta_167529_25mM <- droplevels(meta_167529[keep_25mM, ])
meta_167529_25mM$age_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(meta_167529_25mM$age))

iso_90514_aligned <- iso_90514[, rownames(meta_90514)]
iso_167529_all42  <- iso_167529[, rownames(meta_167529)]
iso_167529_25mM   <- iso_167529[, rownames(meta_167529_25mM)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save clean .rds files to shared group_4/data folder
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_dir <- "../data/"

saveRDS(gene_90514,        file.path(data_dir, "GSE90514_gene_counts.rds"))
saveRDS(iso_90514_aligned, file.path(data_dir, "GSE90514_iso_counts.rds"))
saveRDS(meta_90514,        file.path(data_dir, "GSE90514_meta.rds"))

saveRDS(gene_167529_25mM,  file.path(data_dir, "GSE167529_25mM_gene_counts.rds"))
saveRDS(iso_167529_25mM,   file.path(data_dir, "GSE167529_25mM_iso_counts.rds"))
saveRDS(meta_167529_25mM,  file.path(data_dir, "GSE167529_25mM_meta.rds"))

saveRDS(gene_167529,       file.path(data_dir, "GSE167529_all42_gene_counts.rds"))
saveRDS(iso_167529_all42,  file.path(data_dir, "GSE167529_all42_iso_counts.rds"))
saveRDS(meta_167529,       file.path(data_dir, "GSE167529_all42_meta.rds"))

list.files(data_dir)
```

# -------- Differential Isoform Usage ---------------

Paths are relative to this file (the `R/` folder).
```{r}
data_dir    <- "../data/"
results_dir <- "../results"
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

Isoform counts and metadata for both datasets. GSE167529 uses the 25 mM glucose samples only (21 samples, one per donor).
```{r}
iso_prkn   <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "GSE90514_iso_counts.rds"))
meta_prkn  <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "GSE90514_meta.rds"))
iso_lrrk2  <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "GSE167529_25mM_iso_counts.rds"))
meta_lrrk2 <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "GSE167529_25mM_meta.rds"))
```

Isoform annotation (links each transcript to its gene). This file is not in the repo, so it keeps its full path on the server.
```{r}
isoInfo <- read_rds("/home/projects/22140/exam_data/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.107.chr_patch_hapl_scaff_tx_info.Rds")
```


```{r}
prkn_file <- file.path(results_dir, "03_GSE90514_dexseq.rds")
lrrk2_file <- file.path(results_dir, "03_GSE167529_dexseq.rds")
```
